name: decrement_strong_count
rules: The pointer must have been obtained through `Rc::into_raw`.
The pointer must satisfy the layout requirements specified in `Rc::from_raw_in`.
The associated `Rc` instance must be valid, with a strong count of at least 1, when `Rc::decrement_strong_count` is invoked.
The pointer must point to a block of memory allocated by the global allocator.
`Rc::decrement_strong_count` must not be called after the final associated `Rc` has been released.
